Please do not publish sensitive vulnerability details in a public issue.

请不要在公开 issue 中发布敏感漏洞细节。

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting if available, or contact the maintainer through the repository owner profile. See `SECURITY.md`.

如果可用，请使用 GitHub 私有漏洞报告；否则请通过仓库所有者主页联系维护者。详见 `SECURITY.md`。
